en: Black‑and‑white view of a European small‑town street with historic gabled houses and two church or town‑hall towers in the background. The facades carry German inscriptions for a savings bank, an inn called "Zum Ratskeller", a lodging "Auspannung", a shop "Gustav Ziermann" and a pharmacy or drugstore with a red‑cross sign. Trees frame the scene on the left and a horse is visible at the right edge. The sky area is damaged, suggesting an old photograph reproduced as a postcard.
